_comment: Our own additions on top of the upstream OPML. One object per feed: feedURL and title required; categories (ids from categories.json) required; regions (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), siteURL, summary, language optional. An entry whose feedURL matches an upstream feed overrides its title/summary/siteURL/language and adds its categories/regions.
